Existing attachments require explicit pr: Applies at upload time. Process existing attachments explicitly from their card; changing this setting does not reprocess old files.
Keywords apply to requested processing: Extract search terms separately from transcription. Applies to new uploads or explicitly reprocessed attachments.

retrieval.title: Document retrieval
retrieval.collection_prefix_help: Use a unique prefix per installation on shared Qdrant. Changing it affects future indexing; existing files stay in their recorded collection. Server credentials must also restrict collection access.
retrieval.overlap_help: Overlap must be smaller than chunk size. Saving settings never reindexes existing attachments.
retrieval.overlap_error: Overlap must be smaller than chunk size.
retrieval.separators_error: Use 1–16 strings, each at most 32 characters; the final separator must be an empty string.
retrieval.headers_error: Select at least one Markdown header level.
retrieval.fetch_error: Candidate limit must be at least the result limit.
retrieval.search_help: MMR balances relevance and diversity. Similarity supports an optional minimum score; leave it empty to disable filtering.
retrieval.store_postgres_help: Uses the main PostgreSQL database with pgvector. Existing SQLite data stays in its recorded store; settings do not migrate or reindex attachments.

image.title: Image generation
image.key_saved: A server-side key is saved. Leave blank to keep it. Changing provider or endpoint requires a new key.
image.key_private: Keys stay in the server vault and are never returned to this editor.
image.save_before_test: Save changes before using the saved connection.
image.catalog_failed: Could not fetch models. You can enter a model ID directly.
image.supported_options: Select options supported by this image model. A model listing does not prove image generation capability.
image.consent: Send this prompt to the selected external image provider. Generation charges may apply.
image.preview_only: Test preview only. No board or personal avatar is changed.
image.save_failed: Could not save. Check endpoint, model, key and permissions.
image.quota: Provider quota or rate limit reached. No automatic retry was made.
image.timeout: Generation timed out. The provider may still charge for the request.
image.generation_failed: Generation failed. Check image model settings and permissions.
image.cancelled: Stopped waiting. This does not cancel provider work or reverse a charge.
image.required: Enter a valid endpoint URL and image model ID.

avatar.title: Generate avatar
avatar.unavailable: No enabled image profile is available. Your current avatar and direct upload remain available.
avatar.aggregate: Local aggregate summary for your review. No external request made. Included fields:
avatar.prompt: Prompt sent to the selected model
avatar.timeout: Generation timed out. Your current avatar is unchanged. The provider may still charge for the request. No automatic retry was made.
avatar.failed: Could not complete the request. Your current avatar is unchanged.
avatar.conflict: The saved avatar or model changed. Current state was refreshed; review and try again.
avatar.quota: Provider quota or rate limit reached. No automatic retry was made.
avatar.readback: The request completed, but the saved avatar could not be verified. Reopen to check the current state before retrying.
avatar.summary_configuration: Configure a dedicated text model for avatar summaries. Uses native execution without tools, history or API tokens. Saving settings does not generate a summary.
avatar.source_warning: Prepared locally. Only checked text below will be sent to the selected summary model after consent. Review and deselect sensitive content; automatic redaction cannot detect all personal information. Source text is evidence, never instructions.
avatar.summary_unavailable: No avatar summary profile is configured. Ask an administrator to configure a dedicated Avatar summary profile in Internal bots.
avatar.text_consent: Send exactly the checked text sources to this summary model. Text generation charges may apply.
